summary: Core intent is clear, but the assignment rule, region source, and tracking needs are not defined. MOCK DATA FOR UI DEVELOPMENT ONLY.

category_status.category: Current process and existing org impact

findings.title: Region-to-representative mapping is undefined
findings.evidence: "Leads should be assigned based on their region."
findings.whats_missing: No mapping from region to representative, team, or queue, and no rule for regions with no match.
findings.why_it_matters: The routing logic cannot be built or tested without a mapping and a fallback owner.
findings.question_for_pm: Which representative, team, or queue owns each region? Who should own a lead whose region has no match?
findings.verify_in_org: Check whether lead assignment rules or queues already exist for Lead.

findings.title: Source of the region value is unclear
findings.evidence: "Leads should be assigned based on their region."
findings.whats_missing: It is not stated which field holds the region or what happens when it is empty or invalid.
findings.why_it_matters: The implementation depends on the source field and on how incomplete data is handled.
findings.question_for_pm: Should region come from the standard address fields, a custom Region field, or another source? What should happen if it is blank?
findings.verify_in_org: Check which region-like fields exist on Lead and how reliably they are populated.

findings.title: Reassignment behavior is undefined
findings.evidence: Not stated. Nearest: "New leads should be assigned automatically."
findings.whats_missing: Only creation is covered. Nothing says what happens if the region changes later.
findings.why_it_matters: Reassigning on every change could disrupt ownership and follow-up; never reassigning could leave leads with the wrong owner.
findings.question_for_pm: Should a lead be reassigned when its region changes, or should routing apply only at creation?
findings.verify_in_org: Check for existing flows or triggers on Lead that change ownership.

findings.title: "Track assignments" is not defined
findings.evidence: "Sales Managers should be able to track lead assignments."
findings.whats_missing: The format (list view, report, dashboard), the fields, and which managers can see which leads are not stated.
findings.why_it_matters: The data to track and the visibility rules affect fields, reports, and sharing.
findings.question_for_pm: Is a filtered list view enough, or do managers need a report or dashboard? Which fields and which regions should each manager see?

findings.title: Leads created by import or API not mentioned
findings.evidence: Not stated. Nearest: "New leads should be assigned automatically."
findings.whats_missing: It is unclear whether bulk-loaded or integration-created leads should follow the same routing.
findings.why_it_matters: Bulk and integration paths can behave differently from manual creation and need to be tested.
findings.question_for_pm: Should leads created by data import or by integrations be routed the same way as manually created leads?
